tree.heading: Waiver
tree.text: The cost-sharing requirements under section 1862o-14(c) of this title for the Major Research Instrumentation Program and under section 1862n-1a(i) of this title for teaching fellowships administered within the Robert Noyce Teacher Scholarship Program are waived for a period of 5 years following August 9, 2022.

tree.heading: Assessment
tree.text: Not later than 5 years following August 9, 2022, the Director shall submit to Congress an assessment, that includes feedback from the research community, of the impacts of the waivers provided under subsection (a), including—

children.text: institutional commitment and stewardship of Federal resources;
institutional strategic planning and administrative burden;
recommendations for or against extending or making permanent such waivers.
